newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile receives no cadmium offers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile receives no cadmium offers.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it received no offers for cadmium in the offering held July 8.
The initial bid opening for cadmium under the new solicitation, DLA-Cadmium-002, will be held July 23, Stockpile said.
Approximately 935,908 lbs of cadmium will be sold by sealed bid for the remainder of the fiscal year 1997, which ends Sept 30.
The minimum quantity bid for material is 1,000 lbs.
If all the material is not sold, subsequent openings will be held on the fourth Wednesday of each month.
